Tiszakanyar Jewish Cemetery One

Jewish Cemetery · Iskola utca 4, Hungary

Not demolished. One of two Jewish cemeteries once maintained by Tiszakanyár — a village whose entire Jewish population never exceeded 28 people, drawn from a handful of families, chiefly those named Klein. Only 2 gravestones survive today, sitting outside the cemetery's original cadastral boundary within what is now the municipal cemetery; the rest of the Jewish section has been partially overbuilt as a Christian burial ground. The three Klein-family households here were taken to the Kisvárda Ghetto in April 1944 and deported to Auschwitz by the end of that May.
